s: the roastery café that helped launch Tokyo's third-wave coffee scene
w: Opened in 2012 in a renovated old house near Nakameguro Station, this flagship helped kick off Tokyo's specialty-coffee wave. Beans are roasted on-site and sourced through direct relationships with producing farms; the exposed timber and small counter became a template copied across the chain's other Tokyo branches.
_facts: Opened in 2012 in a renovated traditional house
Flagship location of the Onibus Coffee roastery chain
Credited as an early driver of Tokyo's specialty/third-wave coffee scene
